newsitem.title: USA: Developed Technology net first profit.
newsitem.headline: Developed Technology net first profit.

text.p: Developed Technology Resource Inc on Monday reported a net profit of $69,824, or $0.07, a for its second quarter ended April 30, 1997, the first profitable quarter in the company's history.

DTR manages FoodMaster International LLC, a Delaware company owned 40 percent by Developed Technology, 60 percent by Agribusiness Partners International LLC. Developed Technology is building a food and dairy business within the former Soviet Union.
In the same quarter of last year, the company incurred a net loss of $70,473 or $0.08 a share.

During the quarter, Developed Technology said it expanded its dairy operations in the former Soviet Union. Its Kazakhstan locations are now generating sales of just under $800,000 per month and it said it expects continued growth.
The company also started production in Moldova.
